newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iran seeks 50,000 tns optional barley - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran seeks 50,000 tns optional barley - traders.

text.p: Iran will tender for the import of 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley on March 17, European grain traders said on Thursday.
The barley is for shipment in May, they said.

Traders said the tender was not part of an international operation to provide relief to Iran after an earthquake struck the agricultural province of Ardabil in the northwest. "The tender is a strictly commercial operation," one trader said.
Last week Iran appealed for 100,000 tonnes of barley to feed 200,000 head of livestock in the quake-stricken northwest.
